title: MattSpy
description: MattSpy is a plugin for survival servers.
body:
MattSpy is a versatile Minecraft plugin designed to help administrators and moderators monitor and manage player activities discreetly. With powerful commands, it offers full control and flexibility for server management.

Features:
Spy Mode: Use /spy to toggle real-time monitoring of player messages and commands.
Spectator Mode: Enter spectator mode with /mattspy:spec for invisible observation.
Nicknames: Change your display name instantly using /mattspy:nick <name>.
Inventory Management: Use /invsee <player> to access and modify other players' inventories.
Standalone Plugin: No dependencies required for smooth functionality.

Compatible with Minecraft 1.20.1, MattSpy is the ultimate tool for ensuring a fair and well-managed server environment.
